---
title: "Training Content Pages"
---

---


Use the training content pages to provide learning materials and activities for your participants.

You can organise the pages to suit the structure of your training (for example: by day, module, topic, or section) or structure them around what participants need to learn and do.

In this template, the pages demonstrate how to use Markdown and Quarto to organise and format content. They are examples to adapt when building your own training pages. Replace the example material with your own, and remove any examples or sections you do not need.

The template pages cover:

- [**Module 1 – How to structure a page:**](/content/module-1/introduction.qmd) Headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, code blocks, and text formatting.
- [**Module 2 – How to highlight information:**](/content/module-2/introduction.qmd) Callouts for tips, notes, important information, and warnings, as well as reflection questions.
- [**Module 3 – How to add media and interactive elements:**](/content/module-3/introduction.qmd) Links, images, videos, and exercises.
